import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
theorem final_dev_0111 (n : ℤ) (h : n^2 % 4 = 0) : even n := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem final_dev_0111 (n : ℤ) (h : n^2 % 4 = 0) : even n := by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := int.exists_eq_add_one_of_even n
  have h1 : (2 * k + 1)^2 % 4 ≠ 0 := by
    calc
      (2 * k + 1)^2 % 4 = ((2 * k + 1) * (2 * k + 1)) % 4 ·
      = (4 * k^2 + 4 * k + 1) % 4 ·
      = 1 % 4 ·
      = 1
    <;> exact this
  have h2 : n^2 % 4 = 0 := h
  rw [h1, h2]
  exact int.zero_ne_one
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : @Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0111 = @Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0111 := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
#print axioms Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0111

run_cmd do
  let expectedInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0111
  let candidateInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0111
  unless expectedInfo.levelParams.length == candidateInfo.levelParams.length do
    throwError "Fixed theorem universe-parameter arity mismatch"
  let candidateType := candidateInfo.type.instantiateLevelParams candidateInfo.levelParams (expectedInfo.levelParams.map Lean.Level.param)
  Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
    unless (← Lean.Meta.isDefEq expectedInfo.type candidateType) do
      throwError "Fixed theorem closed declaration types differ"
